messages:
Lina (Frontend): quick note from today's usability run: the compact tool-calling preview traps focus on the close button; keyboard users can't reach argument inputs or tool actions.
Maya (Design): repro steps? I saw a similar thing but thought it was expected.
Lina (Frontend): open fn -> Preview -> Tab. focus lands on X then cycles. expected: Tab should move into the panel body (tool list or first arg).
Omar (A11y): suggested fix: set dialog initial focus to the panel body, implement roving tabindex for the tool list, add role=listbox/option and an sr-only keyboard hint linked with aria-describedby. ensure Esc closes and focus returns to the invoking control.
Ben (DevEx): we use focus-lock which defaults to the first tabbable (close). small change to initialFocus selector should be straightforward.
Maya (Design): copy tweak: header -> "Invocation preview" + tiny info icon that is keyboardable; full instruction in sr-only text so SR users get the full sentence.
Lina (Frontend): mobile note: avoid auto-focus on narrow viewports to prevent keyboard pop. use a bottom-sheet pattern on small screens and require tap to focus.
Ben (DevEx): rollout plan: 1) change initialFocus to .panel-body (small PR) 2) add aria roles + sr-only hint 3) storybook + e2e keyboard tests 4) ship behind feature flag for a11y lab.
CI-Bot: added e2e tasks PLG-KEY-223 (panel focus order) and PLG-KEY-224 (roving list navigation).
Omar (A11y): PR checklist to include in description: focus order, aria roles, escape behavior, return-focus, screen reader announcement, mobile behavior. I will validate in the lab after merge.
Maya (Design): tiny unrelated nit: run-history rows truncate function names mid-word, looks awkward. prefer ellipsis at word boundary + tooltip with full name.
Lina (Frontend): will switch to text-overflow: ellipsis and add title + compact metadata panel on hover/focus.
Ben (DevEx): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playground/pull/732 — tagging @Lina @Omar. aiming to canary behind ff this week.
Maya (Design): thanks team — ping me for micro-copy polish. :sparkles:
